options.name: SignPath Foundation
options.next_steps: Clarify the installer and original-code licence grant, publish a verifiable source/build process, define signing roles and policy, then apply. Acceptance is not guaranteed.

options.name: Azure Artifact Signing
options.cost: Basic advertised at USD 9.99/month for up to 5000 signatures; verify local billing before purchase
options.eligibility: Public trust supports organizations in the EU and Norway among other listed locations. Individual developers are currently limited to the USA and Canada. Azure account ownership alone does not establish eligibility.

options.name: Microsoft Store MSIX
options.notes: Store certification and packaging work are required. Microsoft re-signs MSIX packages. This is different from submitting an existing EXE/MSI, which still needs publisher signing.

important: A trusted Authenticode signature identifies the publisher and protects the EXE. It does not guarantee immediate SmartScreen reputation or absence of antivirus false positives; EV is not an instant bypass.
